prompt:
Pixel-art ground texture for a top-down JRPG map: the top of rock walls in a mine seen from above: dark rock with veins of glinting copper and blue ore The square is about 256 x 256 art pixels (each art pixel about 7x7 image pixels).
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Camera: classic top-down RPG map view (seen from above at a steep angle, like a 16-bit era overworld/town map), orthographic, no perspective convergence.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO light sources, NO glow, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
It must be a SEAMLESS TILEABLE texture: the left edge continues into the right edge and the top edge into the bottom edge. Fill the entire square edge to edge with the surface only: no border, no frame, no objects, no characters, no text, no single focal feature, even distribution of detail.
revised_prompt: Generate a square seamless tileable ground texture for a top-down JRPG map, depicting ONLY the horizontal tops of rugged mine rock walls seen from above. Dark charcoal and earthy slate rock with irregular subtle veins and small glints of copper ore and muted blue ore, evenly scattered over the entire area, no focal point. Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art, hand-placed crisp uniform square pixels, clusters of 3–10 art pixels with strongly legible angular shapes. Consistent enlarged pixel grid, each art pixel approximately 7–8 image pixels square; nearest-neighbor appearance, no antialiasing. Rich restrained earthy palette, 4–6 shades per material; saturated purplish-red shadow colors and warmer yellowish highlights. Neutral soft even upper-left lighting, base color texture only, no cast shadows, no glow, no vignette, no light sources. Orthographic steep overhead classic RPG view. Truly seamless wrap: features crossing left border must continue at the same vertical position on the right border, and features crossing top border must continue at same horizontal position on bottom border. Fill square edge to edge with rock surface, no border, no framing, no objects, no characters, no words. No soft brushes, photographic textures, noise, checkerboard dithering or blur.
